description: Checks whether an email address accepts mail: a verdict (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown) with its reason, the flags (disposable, role address, catch-all…), the safe action for a sign-up form, and a likely correction of a misspelt domain. Charged per check from your balance; the sandbox (a pt_test_ key) is free.

timeout.description: Milliseconds allowed for the mail server, 1000 to 45000 (the default); past it the address comes back unknown, free.

name: verify_email_address
title: Verify an email address
